Sure thing! To add a new SQL Server instance at `http://plgah.ca`, I’ll need a few details first:

| What you’ll need | Why it matters |
|------------------|----------------|
| **Server address** | You already gave `http://plgah.ca`. |
| **Port number** | Default is 1433, but it might be different. |
| **Database name** | Which database you want to connect to. |
| **Username & password** | Credentials with sufficient privileges. |
| **Authentication type** | Windows Auth vs. SQL Server Auth. |
| **Optional: SSL/TLS settings** | If you need encrypted connections. |

Once you have those, I can walk you through adding the server in DartFX (or any other tool you’re using). Let me know the details, and we’ll get it set up!
